Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciated the context on the triage assistant and the volume expectations. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Summary of needs:
- Use case: clinical triage assistant (patient intake -> routing + summary + suggested next steps)
- Languages: primary = English, secondary = Spanish + Portuguese (short-form summaries, NLU across languages)
- Data sensitivity: PHI-lite (de-identified patient notes) but we need clear controls and audit logs
- Target: baseline POC with 2-week evaluation window and clear success criteria

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
1) Intent classification accuracy >= 90% on our internal labeled set (macro F1)
2) Extractive entity recall for key fields (symptom, duration, severity) >= 92%
3) Avg response latency <= 300 ms (95th pct <= 600 ms) under QPS 10 with batching
4) Multilingual parity: Spanish/Portuguese performance within 6 points of English on main metrics
5) No data exfiltration; audit logs retained for 90 days (we’ll provide SOC2/infra details)

Model guidance we discussed (open models):
- Primary candidate: Llama-3 13B (int8 quant) — good instruction-following / NLU, has strong multi-lingual capability with tuning
- Fallback: Mistral-Instruct 7B (quant) or mpt-7b-instruct for cost-sensitive tests

Proposed POC plan & timeline:
- Kickoff: week of Mar 23
- Week 1: dataset ingestion & baseline runs (3 business days), small prompt engineering loop
- Week 2: systematic eval, metric collection, and joint review; final decision by end of two weeks

Ownership / next steps:

Quick recommendation after an initial pass: 
Primary model (POC baseline):
- Llama-3 13B (int8 quant) — expected to hit high NLU quality and decent multilingual behavior. With int8 quant and optimized kernels we should expect ~150–300 ms p95 latency on a single A10 / T4-class card with batching tuned for QPS 10 and avg context 512.

Fallback / cost-optimized candidate:
- Mistral-Instruct 7B (int8) or mpt-7b-instruct — lower cost, faster infer but may drop a few points on NLU metrics. Good for stress tests and fallback routing.

Multilingual notes:
- Llama-3 shows reasonable Spanish performance out of the box; Portuguese may lag slightly. For parity we can test two options: (1) prompt engineering + few-shot examples, (2) small adapter fine-tune on ~500 labeled Spanish examples. For the POC we recommend (1) and collect error cases to decide on (2).

Infra & perf estimate:
- Recommended instance: 1x NVIDIA A10 (or equivalent) for initial POC; if they need concurrent sessions bump to 2x.
- Config: int8 quant, continuous batching window 20–40ms, KV cache enabled for multi-turn cases.
- Expected throughput: QPS 10 with average 512-token context -> 150–300ms p95 on A10; CPU/RAM requirements modest; storage for logs + audit retained 90 days.
- Rough cost estimate (hosted): ~$1,200–$1,800/week for dedicated POC capacity depending on instance and reserved slots. We’ll refine after we see the sample data and prompt lengths.

Proposed POC tasks (owner):
1) Provision infra and baseline model -> Dev Patel (lead) — 2 business days
2) Ingest sanitized sample and run baseline prompts -> Rishi (support) — 1–2 business days
3) Collect metrics and tune prompts -> Dev + Rishi — 3 business days
4) Joint review with customer -> Marissa + Anna/Carlos -> end of week 2

I’ll prepare a short tech appendix (model config, perf knobs, required S3 layout) and drop in the Drive link by EOD.
